newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures recover on export enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures recover on export enquiries.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery recovered seven rupees per quintal to 1,214/1,215 rupees on fresh speculative buying at reduced levels, traders said.
"Fewer export enquiries and a slowdown in arrivals prompted fresh speculative buying," said a trader.
Arrivals in India's western state of Gujarat, the country's main castorseed producer, dropped to 30,000 bags (75 kg each) on Monday from 40,000/45,000 bags.
Groundnut oil was steady at 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 60/70 tonnes but sentiment was subdued on reports of rising new crop arrivals of rapeseed.
Imported palm-oil gained four rupees to 281/282 rupees per 10 kg as reports of an uptrend in the Malaysian market halted fresh offerings by importers in the local market, traders said.
In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil was steady at 512/513 rupees per 15 kg.
